verdict.rationale: Copilot documents its own capability to connect MCP servers to Copilot Chat to bring in context from other applications, and says it works with project tools and chat apps. However, no evidence names Jira, Slack, or Google Drive connectors specifically. Integration appears to depend on MCP servers that are third-party or that you build yourself (docs-21). missing for 10: documented first-party connectors for Jira, Slack and Google Drive, setup details for these tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: Connect MCP servers to Copilot Chat to share context from other applications.
Copilot works where you do—in GitHub, your IDE, the CLI, project tools, chat apps, and custom MCP servers.
You can create a new MCP server to fulfill your specific needs, and then integrate it with Copilot Chat.
